text:
olivia-pm: Drafting release notes + internal announce for the rollout later this week. Need copy eyes and a pin/change-window. PTAL.

olivia-pm: RELEASE NOTES DRAFT:
- Serving runtime: improved dynamic batching (up to 2x throughput for short requests) and smarter KV cache hits.
- Routing: policy-driven fallback to quantized variants for capacity pressure; reduces tail latency.
- Optimize: default recommenders for batching/quantization now surfaced in Console.
- Ops: canary deploy + automatic rollback hook on error rate spike >= 3% over 5m.

olivia-pm: Internal announce (proposed):
"Heads up — rolling update to inference runtime with batching + routing improvements. Expected benefits: lower per-token costs for bursty traffic and better latency stability. Canary starts in the AM change window; ops will monitor and rollback automatically on regressions. See internal release notes for details and customer-facing blurb."

kevin-engrel: :eyes: overall looks good. please add precise rollback playbook link and canary cadence (e.g., 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m steps)

maria-ops: Is there any SLA impact during canary? Need to tell support what to expect for noisy logs or transient errors. Also confirm DB/kv schema is untouched.

dan-release: Two asks: 1) DO NOT change customer model pinning by default in this rollout — only enable routing policy for non-pinned traffic. 2) Add note about version pin config: how to pin back to v1.12 if issue.

sarah-docs: I can polish the internal blurb. Can someone give me one-line TL;DR for #general (non-technical)?

olivia-pm: Answering: rollback playbook link: https://redwood.internal/releases/rollbacks#1829 (add to final notes). Canary cadence: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%, 15m between ramps with health checks. No SLA change expected; canary is limited and auto-rollback triggers on error-rate/regression. KV schema unchanged.

olivia-pm: Pin suggestion: schedule the overall change window for 2026-03-24 09:00-11:00 PST. Ops: is that safe? If so I'll pin the announcement for 08:45.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout: canary start at 2026-03-24T09:00:00-08:00 (PST). Canary stages: 5%,25%,60%,100%. Auto-rollback hooks registered.

kevin-engrel: Add extra line for observability: enable verbose tracing for first 20m of canary only, then revert to normal sampling. Also add a note in the Console about per-route fallbacks so SEs can explain to customers.

sarah-docs: TL;DR for #general: "Performance update to inference routing — improves latency and cost for short requests; gradual rollout with automatic rollback if any regressions." Want it shorter?

maria-ops: Confirmed change window works for infra. On-call will be: maria-ops, kevin-engrel, dan-release. I also enabled a temporary alert mute for noisy alerts during ramp to avoid paging on known transient spikes.

dan-release: Ack from release. If everyone signs off, olivia, please pin the announce at 08:45 and mention the rollback link. I'll monitor the canary dashboard.

olivia-pm: Thanks all — will finalize copy with SARAH's TL;DR and pin for 08:45 PST. I'll paste final internal note here before pin. :thumbsup:
